steps.title: Meet Raju
steps.narration: A GST-verified buyer from Delhi. Busy on IndiaMART: 10 enquiries, 20 seller calls and 10 buy-leads in 90 days. Yet every bot still greets him like a stranger.

steps.title: Meera already remembers him
steps.narration: Five days ago Raju was looking for 200 Polo T-shirts. One seller connected, Delhi Knit House quoted ₹240 a piece, and then it went quiet. That unfinished deal is a thread.

steps.title: He's back: searching Polo T-shirts again
steps.narration: Today he searches 'Polo T shirt' again. Same mcat, so it lands on the same thread instead of starting over. Meera knows a returning buyer.

steps.title: A call that didn't connect
steps.narration: He calls Delhi Knit House, the seller on his old lead. The call has no mcat, but Delhi Knit House is already on this thread, so it lands in the right place.

steps.title: Meera calls Raju
steps.narration: Meera calls Raju over the internet. It opens with his unfinished Polo deal, not a generic hello. He changes the quantity.
suggest: Haan, par ab 500 piece chahiye, Diwali se pehle
Logo embroidery ke saath, quotes WhatsApp pe bhej do

turns: Namaste Raju ji! Aap phir se Polo T-Shirt dekh rahe hain. Pichli baar 200 piece ki requirement thi, aur Delhi Knit House ne ₹240 per piece quote kiya tha. Kya abhi bhi wahi requirement hai?
Haan, par ab 500 piece chahiye, Diwali se pehle, logo embroidery ke saath.
Ji. Kya main ye requirement responsive sellers ko bhej doon?
Haan, quotes WhatsApp pe bhej do kal tak.
Ji, kal tak quotes WhatsApp pe aa jayenge. Dhanyavaad.

platform_vars.next_step: Send quotes for 500 polo T-shirts with logo embroidery on WhatsApp by tomorrow

steps.title: Next day, on WhatsApp
steps.narration: Next day Raju messages on WhatsApp. The chat picks up where the call stopped. Then he complains about a sample.
suggest: Aur Delhi Knit House ne jo sample bheja tha, uski quality kharab thi

turns: Namaste Raju ji! Pichli baar Web call pe aapki Polo T-Shirt requirement ki baat hui thi. Usi ka update dene ke liye sampark kiya hai. Baat karein?
Ji, aapke 500 pieces ke liye sellers se quotes aa rahe hain. Embroidery ka design aapke paas ready hai?
Haan. Aur Delhi Knit House ne jo sample bheja tha, uski quality kharab thi.
Afsos hua sunke. Ye Delhi Knit House ke sample ki baat hai na?
Ji, maine ise IndiaMART support ko bhej diya hai. Quotes kal tak WhatsApp pe aa jayenge.

steps.title: What's underneath
steps.narration: No magic: two API calls. Every step you saw was a real POST /v1/event, and every screen a real GET /v1/context.
